name: echo ghost sheet
description: Proposal, October, 40 cell lattice (12 px cells, the creature at 2x under a white sheet with a scalloped hem, its antenna poking out of the top and its feet dangling below) floating at night under a crescent moon: the two eye holes sit exactly over the visor, so the ghost's eyes are the teal band and the dark slits from inside, and it blinks through them; it bobs on a slow sine with the hem rolling and its shadow narrowing on the floor, then its hands come up to the hem and lift the sheet into a hood, it looks left, right and out, blinks, shuts its eyes happy with an antenna ping, and drops the sheet again; judge whether it reads at a glance as a sheet ghost, whether the eye holes read as the creature looking out, and whether it is still this creature.
